statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-92392: during an HTTP/2 upload, curl mishandles an RST_STREAM from the server (HTTP_1_1_REQUIRED or REFUSED_STREAM): multi_done() tells the connection filters that the transfer is done before it finishes the request, which can lead to a use after free of the transfer's struct Curl_easy (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-92392.html). It affects curl 8.12.0 to 8.22.0 and was fixed in curl 8.23.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/8b0744af5b1b631da5b938ca31c3f9895ad5a321, which moves the Curl_conn_ev_data_done() call after Curl_req_done(). As of 2026-11-27 the DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0, 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. In the multi_done() function of the static libcurl.a shipped in curl-static, on x86_64 and aarch64, every build before 8.23.0-r0 calls Curl_conn_ev_data_done() before Curl_req_done(), and 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1 call it after, so 8.23.0-r0 is the first fixed build.

It affects curl 8.12.0 to 8.22.0 and was fixed in curl 8.23.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/8b0744af5b1b631da5b938ca31c3f9895ad5a321, which moves the Curl_conn_ev_data_done() call after Curl_req_done(). Debian backported the fix to trixie in 8.14.1-2+deb13u7 (DSA-6558-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-92392). The DHI curl packages for Debian 13 are rebuilds of Debian's trixie curl 8.14.1-2; as of 2026-11-27 the DHI Debian repository publishes three of them (the rebuild of 8.14.1-2+deb13u5 and two rebuilds of 8.14.1-2+deb13u7) for amd64 and arm64. The two rebuilds of 8.14.1-2+deb13u7 ship a Debian changelog that records the CVE-2026-92392 fix; the rebuild of 8.14.1-2+deb13u5 does not have it. The first rebuild of 8.14.1-2+deb13u7 is the fixed version used here.
